description: Work that spans many sessions, each a fresh agent with no memory of the others, coordinated through artifacts the harness persists.
A structured file (JSON) with every unit of work and its status and attempts; the single source of truth for what is left.
An append-only log of what each session did and what failed, read by the next session to get up to speed.
The first session or script that writes the plan; idempotent, so running it again never resets progress.
Starting a session from the files: read the task list and the progress tail, then pick the next pending task.
Writing a new version to a temporary file and renaming it over the old one, so a crash never leaves a half-written state file.
A task that failed verification too many times; set aside with its feedback for a human instead of being retried forever.
